rules.name: ARIA attribute is defined in WAI-ARIA
rules.note: Internal rule judges only attributes of elements in the accessibility tree; ACT applies to every aria-* attribute.

rules.name: ARIA global properties not used where prohibited
rules.note: Both cover aria-label, aria-labelledby and aria-roledescription on roles that prohibit them.

rules.name: Element with aria-hidden has no content in sequential focus navigation
rules.note: Same expectation: no element in sequential focus navigation inside aria-hidden=true.

rules.name: ARIA required context role
rules.note: Internal rule additionally covers a native li under a re-roled list.

rules.name: ARIA required ID references exist
ARIA required owned elements
rules.note: Internal rule also passes aria-expanded=false containers, which ACT does not exempt.

rules.name: ARIA state or property is permitted
rules.note: Internal rule additionally applies the stricter ARIA in HTML restrictions for native elements.

rules.name: ARIA state or property has valid value
rules.note: Internal rule covers enumerated, integer and number types; ID reference types are a separate rule.

rules.name: Attribute is not duplicated
Audio element content is media alternative for text
Audio or video element avoids automatically playing audio
rules.note: Internal rule covers audio only and ends in review; ACT also covers video and is a composite of two sub-rules.

rules.name: Audio element content has text alternative
rules.note: Internal rule is manual (review only).

rules.name: Audio element content has transcript
Audio or video element that plays automatically has no audio that lasts more than 3 seconds
Audio or video element that plays automatically has a control mechanism
Text content that changes automatically can be paused, stopped or hidden
rules.note: Both relate to SC 2.2.2, but the internal rule judges CSS animations while ACT judges auto-updating text content. Relation not established.

rules.name: Autocomplete attribute has valid value
rules.note: Both validate the HTML autofill token grammar.

rules.name: Block of repeated content is collapsible
Button has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: Same applicability and expectation (empty accessible name).

rules.name: Bypass Blocks of Repeated Content
rules.note: Composite rule. Internal rule accepts headings, a main landmark or a skip link as bypass mechanism and reports review without a repeated block; no collapsible-block check.

rules.name: Orientation of the page is not restricted using CSS transforms
rules.note: Internal rule checks rotation of html/body in the audited viewport; ACT checks any element with a conditional orientation media query.

rules.name: Device motion based changes to the content can be disabled
Device motion based changes to the content can also be created from the user interface
Document has heading for non-repeated content
rules.note: Sub-rule of cf77f2; headings/none is mapped there as a whole.

rules.name: Document has an instrument to move focus to non-repeated content
rules.note: Sub-rule of cf77f2; the internal skip-link check is review only.

rules.name: Document has a landmark with non-repeated content
rules.note: Sub-rule of cf77f2; landmarks are not judged as repeated-content bypass separately.

rules.name: HTML element language subtag matches language
Element with lang attribute has valid language tag
Element marked as decorative is not exposed
SVG element with explicit role has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: Internal rule fails for explicit img/graphics roles and reviews svg without role.

rules.name: Focusable element has no keyboard trap
rules.note: Internal rule is manual (review only).

rules.name: Focusable element has no keyboard trap via non-standard navigation
Focusable element has no keyboard trap via standard navigation
Form field label is descriptive
Form field has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: Union of the two internal rules covers the ACT role list; neither rule alone does.

rules.name: Heading is descriptive
Heading has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: Same expectation: non-empty accessible name of headings.

rules.name: HTML page has lang attribute
rules.note: Both require a non-empty lang on the root html element. html-has-lang judges iframe documents and is not part of this ACT rule.

rules.name: HTML page language subtag matches default language
HTML page lang attribute has valid language tag
rules.note: Both check the primary language subtag of a non-empty page lang.

rules.name: HTML page lang and xml:lang attributes have matching values
rules.note: Both compare primary subtags of lang and xml:lang. The ACT rule is deprecated.

rules.name: HTML page has non-empty title
rules.note: Union of the two internal rules covers a missing and an empty title.

rules.name: HTML page title is descriptive
rules.note: Internal rule only flags known placeholder titles (F25); descriptiveness is a human judgement. Heuristic: not reported as ACT result.

rules.name: Id attribute value is unique
rules.note: Internal rule only reviews duplicate ids that are referenced; ACT applies to every id. The ACT rule is deprecated (SC 4.1.1 removed in WCAG 2.2).

rules.name: Iframe elements with identical accessible names have equivalent purpose
Iframe element has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: ACT excludes iframes with negative tabindex; internal rule judges every iframe in the accessibility tree.

rules.name: Iframe with interactive elements is not excluded from tab-order
Image accessible name is descriptive
rules.note: Internal rule flags file names and filler words as review; descriptiveness is a human judgement. Heuristic: not reported as ACT result.

rules.name: Image button has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: Same: an image button needs a name that is not the browser default.

rules.name: Image filename is accessible name for image
rules.note: Deprecated, superseded by qt1vmo.

rules.name: HTML images contain no text
Image has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: Internal rules split img (images/alt-missing) and role=img (image-alt); ACT also accepts role none/presentation as pass.

rules.name: Image not in the accessibility tree is decorative
Important letter spacing in style attributes is wide enough
rules.note: ACT checks !important letter spacing in style attributes; internal text-spacing applies the SC 1.4.12 overrides and compares clipping. Relation not established.

rules.name: Important line height in style attributes is wide enough
rules.note: ACT checks !important line height in style attributes; internal rules test different conditions. Relation not established.

rules.name: Important word spacing in style attributes is wide enough
rules.note: ACT checks !important word spacing in style attributes; internal text-spacing applies the SC 1.4.12 overrides and compares clipping. Relation not established.

rules.name: Error message describes invalid form field value
rules.note: Internal rule checks that an error is identified, not that the message describes the invalid value.

rules.name: Link is descriptive
rules.note: Internal rule flags generic link names as review; descriptiveness is a human judgement. Heuristic: not reported as ACT result.

rules.name: Link in context is descriptive
rules.note: Internal rule flags generic link names as review; descriptiveness is a human judgement. Heuristic: not reported as ACT result.

rules.name: Link has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: links/name-missing covers a[href]; role=link elements are judged by names/required-missing.

rules.name: Links with identical accessible names have equivalent purpose
Links with identical accessible names and same context serve equivalent purpose
Menuitem has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: menuitem is in the role list of names/required-missing.

rules.name: Meta element has no refresh delay
rules.note: Same 20-hour exception (71999 s fails, 72000 s passes). Internal rule judges every refresh meta, not only the first.

rules.name: Meta element has no refresh delay (no exception)
rules.note: Internal rule keeps the 20-hour exception that this variant removes, so it misses delays of 20 hours or more.

rules.name: Meta viewport allows for zoom
rules.note: Both fail user-scalable=no/0 and maximum-scale below 2.

rules.name: Content has alternative for visual reference
Object element rendering non-text content has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: ACT is limited to objects embedding image, video or audio resources; internal rule judges every object.

rules.name: Element with presentational children has no focusable content
No keyboard shortcut uses only printable characters
Role attribute has valid value
rules.note: Same: at least one valid non-abstract role token.

rules.name: Element with role attribute has required states and properties
rules.note: Internal rule covers a fixed list of roles; ACT covers every role with required states and properties.

rules.name: Scrollable content can be reached with sequential focus navigation
rules.note: Internal rule uses a 13 px overflow tolerance and requires text; ACT compares the scroll distance with the padding.

rules.name: Element in sequential focus order has visible focus
rules.note: Internal rule inspects stylesheets (outline removed without replacement); ACT compares pixels of focused and unfocused element. Heuristic.

rules.name: Summary element has non-empty accessible name
rules.note: Both judge the summary button of a details element.

rules.name: Table header cell has assigned cells
rules.note: Internal rule fails headers in a table without any data cell; ACT assigns cells per header by scope and position.

rules.name: Headers attribute specified on a cell refers to cells in the same table element
rules.note: Internal rule requires header cells of the same table; ACT requires any cell of the same table and not the cell itself.

rules.name: Text has minimum contrast
rules.note: Same thresholds (4.5:1, 3:1 for large text, no rounding); undetermined cases are review, not pass.

rules.name: Text has enhanced contrast
rules.note: Same thresholds (7:1, 4.5:1 for large text).

rules.name: Video element auditory content has accessible alternative
Video element visual content has accessible alternative
Video element content is media alternative for text
Video element visual content has audio description
Video element auditory content has captions
rules.note: Internal rule only checks for a same-origin caption track and otherwise reports untested; it does not decide whether the audio needs captions.

rules.name: Video element visual content has description track
Video element visual-only content has accessible alternative
Video element visual-only content is media alternative for text
Video element visual-only content has audio track alternative
Video element visual-only content has description track
Video element visual-only content has transcript
Video element visual content has strict accessible alternative
Audio and visuals of video element have transcript
Visible label is part of accessible name
rules.note: Both require the visible label to be contained in the accessible name; internal rule adds review for ambiguous composite labels.

rules.name: Zoomed text node is not clipped with CSS overflow
rules.note: ACT checks clipped text at 640x512 with zoomed text; the internal reflow check works at 320 px and text-spacing simulates SC 1.4.12 overrides. Relation not established.
